channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Harness the Future of Streetwear with Jordan Brand and Zalando
item.description: Jordan Brand and Zalando have joined forces to drop a collection of sneakers, shirts, trousers, and more.

item.title: Cat Burns Brings Tommy Jeans To South London
item.description: For Spring 2026, Tommy Jeans turns its focus to London, letting the city’s rhythm shape the mood of the campaign.

item.title: Balmain's Fresh Start Entails An Even Fresher Sneaker
item.description: Ahead of its new creative director's first showing, French luxury house Balmain debuted an ultra-covetable thin-soled sneaker, the palette-cleansing Racer 45.

item.title: A Barbour So Clean It Barely Looks Like Barbour
item.description: BEAUTY & YOUTH’s updates to the Barbour Transport have major repercussions. The jacket barely looks like a Barbour jacket.

item.title: Nike’s Dark-Mode Dad Shoe Is Perfectly Destroyed
item.description: Nike's V5 RNR "Anthracite" sneaker lands with distressed details, advancing the model's stylish run.

item.title: Nike's Craziest, Techiest Air Max Smiles Back
item.description: Nike's Air Max DN8 "Pink Glaze" sneaker debuts as a new edition to the "Have a Nike Day" collection, featuring the classic Swoosh smiley face.

item.title: Nike’s Beautiful Spotted Air Max Is a Pure Mbappé Flex
item.description: Nike releases a reimagined Air Max Plus VII sneaker for Kylian Mbappé, alongside KM-stamped cleats.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Soak In Karl Lagerfeld’s Bath?
item.description: Karl Lagerfeld's old office in central Paris is now a swanky apartment. And if you cough up over $2,300 a night, you can bathe in The Kaiser's bath.

item.title: New Balance’s Techy Waterproof Dad Shoe Is Practically Hike-able
item.description: New Balance's 1906 GORE-TEX sneaker offers waterproof properties & trail-coded details, for a hiking-worthy spin on the techy model.

item.title: adidas' Blacked-Out Cordura Sneaker Is Like a Totally Tough Samba
item.description: adidas' classic Handball Spezial sneaker gets a tough Cordura upgrade as well as a clean all-black colorway.
